name: classroom-mcp
description: Student and class management — roster, timetable, courses, courseware, teaching agents, human-teacher marketplace, AI syllabus generation, and progress tracking

tools.help: List all tools with one-line descriptions
tools.status: Server health: version, ports, DB path, tool count
tools.student_create: Create or update a student by email
tools.student_update: Update a student's fields by ID
tools.class_list: List all classes with student counts
tools.class_update: Update a class's fields by ID
tools.class_add_student: Add a student to a class
tools.class_remove_student: Remove a student from a class
tools.assignment_create: Create an assignment for a class
tools.assignment_list: List assignments, optionally filtered by class
tools.assignment_create_with_lesson: Create an assignment backed by a learnbot-mcp lesson
tools.progress_list: List progress records, filtered by student or class
tools.course_list: List courses, optionally filtered by subject
tools.course_update: Update a course's fields by ID
tools.module_create: Create a module within a course
tools.module_list: List modules for a course, ordered by sequence
tools.courseware_create: Create courseware (lecture, reading, problem_set, quiz, project)
tools.courseware_list: List courseware items for a module
tools.agent_create: Create or update a teaching agent for a course
tools.agent_list: List teaching agents assigned to a course
tools.human_teacher_get: Get a human teacher by ID
tools.referral_create: Refer a student to a human teacher
tools.referral_list: List referrals, filtered by teacher or status
tools.syllabus_generate: AI-generate a full syllabus (modules + objectives) for a course
tools.courseware_generate_ai: AI-generate courseware content for a module
tools.syllabus_list: List generated syllabus and courseware content
